# High-speed configuration descriptor of a UAC2 sink whose streaming
# alternate settings carry the formats 16/2 PCM and 32/4 IEEE_FLOAT (bit
# resolution/subslot size in bytes), in alternate-setting order. One
# descriptor per line, in hex, wTotalLength bytes in all.
# The class-specific data endpoint descriptors (08 25 01 ...) carry
# bLockDelayUnits 0 and wLockDelay 0: UAC2 4.10.1.2 (p. 87) requires zero
# for an asynchronous endpoint.
# Alternate setting 2 is IEEE_FLOAT: its class-specific AS interface
# descriptor (UAC2 4.9.2, Table 4-27) has bFormatType FORMAT_TYPE_I (01)
# and bmFormats with D2 set, 0x00000004 (Formats A.2.1, Table A-2); its
# Type I format type descriptor (Formats 2.3.1.6, Table 2-2) has
# bSubslotSize 4 and bBitResolution 32 (20), as Formats 2.3.1.7.3 requires.
# Its data endpoint is sized as for PCM: (96 + 1) * 2 * 4 = 776 (0x0308).
09 02 bb 00 02 01 00 80 32
08 0b 00 02 01 00 20 00
09 04 00 00 00 01 01 20 00
09 24 01 00 02 08 2e 00 00
08 24 0a 04 03 07 00 00
11 24 02 01 01 01 00 04 02 03 00 00 00 00 00 00 00
0c 24 03 03 01 03 00 01 04 00 00 00
09 04 01 00 00 01 02 20 00
09 04 01 01 02 01 02 20 00
10 24 01 01 00 01 01 00 00 00 02 03 00 00 00 00
06 24 02 01 02 10
07 05 01 05 84 01 01
08 25 01 00 00 00 00 00
07 05 81 11 04 00 04
09 04 01 02 02 01 02 20 00
10 24 01 01 00 01 04 00 00 00 02 03 00 00 00 00
06 24 02 01 04 20
07 05 01 05 08 03 01
08 25 01 00 00 00 00 00
07 05 81 11 04 00 04
